# LUNAX Marketing

> LUNAX Marketing is an AI-driven e-commerce and digital marketing agency based in Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan, serving brands worldwide. It manages and grows online stores on Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Etsy and bol.com, and provides paid advertising, social media management, website development, graphic design and video editing.

LUNAX Marketing's official website is https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app. It is headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, and is a separate company from similarly named businesses in other countries.

## Services

- [E-Commerce Growth & Management](https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app/ecommerce-1): store management on Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Etsy, TikTok Shop, ManoMano, Cdiscount and bol.com, including listing and SEO optimization, marketplace ads (Amazon PPC and more), FBA and WFS setup, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Digital Marketing](https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app/marketing): 12 disciplines: SEO (including local SEO), PPC on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and Amazon, social media, content, email marketing (Klaviyo), affiliate and influencer marketing, CRO, analytics (GA4, GTM), e-commerce, mobile and video marketing.
- [Website Development](https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app/webdev): Shopify stores, WordPress and WooCommerce sites, landing pages, and custom React, Next.js and Node.js websites and web apps, built fast and SEO-ready.
- [Graphic Design](https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app/graphic-design): brand identities, logos, social media creatives, UI/UX and product visuals.
- [Video Editing](https://lunaxmarketing.vercel.app/video-1): YouTube recaps, Shorts, Reels, TikToks, AI explainers and vlogs, with motion graphics and colour grading in DaVinci Resolve.

## Key facts

- Location: Johar Town, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Clients: brands worldwide, with all collaboration online
- Platforms: Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Etsy, TikTok Shop, ManoMano, Cdiscount, bol.com, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- Approach: AI-assisted research, analysis and automation, reviewed by the team; clear KPIs and regular reporting
- Engagements: one-off projects and ongoing monthly management
